birth.purpose: Your saved profile name, its kana reading and your birth date are used to calculate your own numerology result. Review the saved information below.

birth.reconfirm: Review my information again to choose

birth.parentalConsentRequired: Parental approval is required to save this birth date. Continue through the existing consent page.
